Alif-Laam-Raa . ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik kitab hai jo hum ney tum per nazil ki hai , takay tum logon  ko unn kay perwerdigar kay hukum say andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aao , yani uss zaat kay raastay ki taraf jiss ka iqtidar sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .
woh Allah kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussi ki milkiyat hai . aur afsos hai unn logon  per jo haq ka inkar kertay hain , kiyonkay unhen sakht azab honey wala hai .

woh log jo aakhirat kay muqablay mein duniya ki zindagi ko pasand kertay hain , aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay per aaney say roktay hain , aur uss mein tairrah talash kertay rehtay hain !   woh perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

aur hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool bheja , khud uss ki qoam ki zaban mein bheja , takay woh unn kay samney haq ko achi tarah wazeh ker-sakay .   phir Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat dey deta hai ,   aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

aur hum ney musa ko apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja kay :  apni qoam ko andheron say nikal ker roshni mein lao , aur ( mukhtalif logon  ko ) Allah ney ( khushhali aur bad-haali kay ) jo din dikhaye hain ,   unn kay hawalay say unhen naseehat kero .  haqeeqat yeh hai kay her woh shaks jo sabar aur shukar ka khoogar ho , uss kay liye inn waqiyaat mein bari nishaniyan hain .

woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ney tum per jo inaam kiya hai , ussay yaad rakho kay uss ney tumhen firon kay logon  say nijat di , jo tumhen bad-tareen takleefen phonchatay thay , aur tumharay beton ko zibah ker daaltay , aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay , aur inn tamam waqiyaat mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara zabardast imtihan tha .

aur woh waqt bhi jab tumharay perwerdigar ney aelaan farma diya tha kay agar tum ney waqaee shukar ada kiya to mein tumhen aur ziyada dun ga , aur agar tum ney nashukri ki to yaqeen jano , mera azab bara sakht hai .
aur musa ney kaha tha kay :  agar tum aur zameen per basney walay tamam log bhi nashukri keren , to ( Allah ka koi nuqsan nahi , kiyonkay ) Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

. ( aey kuffaar-e-makkah ! ) kiya tumhen unn logon  ki khabar nahi phonchi jo tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain , qoam-e-nooh , aad , samood aur unn kay baad aaney wali qoamen jinhen Allah kay siwa koi nahi janta .   inn sabb kay paas unn kay Rasool khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye , to unhon ney unn kay mun per apney haath rakh diye ,   aur kaha kay :  jo paygham tumhen dey ker bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain , aur jiss baat ki tum hamen dawat dey rahey ho , uss kay baaray mein hamen bara bhari shak hai .

unn kay payghumberon ney unn say kaha :  kiya Allah kay baaray mein shak hai jo saray aasmano aur zameen ka khaliq hai ? woh tumhen bula raha hai kay tumhari khatir tumharay gunah moaaf kerday , aur tumhen aik muqarrara mauddat tak mohlat dey .    unhon ney kaha kay :  tumhari haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch bhi nahi kay tum aesay hi insan jo jaisay hum hain . tum yeh chahtay ho kay humaray baap dada jinn ki ibadat kertay aaye hain unn say hamen rok do , lehaza koi saaf saaf moajza laaker dikhao .

unn say unn kay payghumberon ney kaha :  hum waqaee tumharay hi jaisay insan hain , lekin Allah apney bandon mein say jiss per chahta hai khusoosi ehsan farma deta hai . aur yeh baat humaray ikhtiyar mein nahi hai kay hum Allah kay hukum kay baghair tumhen koi moajza laa dikhayen , aur mominon ko sirf Allah per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

aur aakhir hum kiyon Allah per bharosa naa rakhen , jabkay uss ney hamen unn raaston ki hidayat dey di hai jinn per hamen chalna hai ? aur tum ney hamen jo takleefen phonchai hain , unn per hum yaqeenan sabar keren gay , aur jinn logon  ko bharosa rakhna ho , unhen Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha , unhon ney apney payghumberon say kaha kay :  hum tumhen apni sarzameen say nikal ker rahen gay , werna tumhen humaray deen mein wapis aana parray ga .  chunacheh unn kay perwerdigar ney unn per wahi bheji kay :  yaqeen rakho , hum inn zalimon ko halak kerden gay ,
aur unn kay baad yaqeenan tumhen zameen mein basayen gay . yeh hai her uss shaks ka sila jo meray samney kharra honey ka khof rakhta aur meri waeed say darta ho .
aur inn kafiron ney khud faisla maanga ,   aur ( nateeja yeh huwa kay ) her deengay maarney wala hatt dharam na-murad ho ker raha .
uss kay aagay jahannum hai , aur ( wahan ) ussay peep ka paani pilaya jaye ga ,

woh ussay ghoont ghoont ker kay piye ga , aur ussay aisa mehsoos hoga kay woh ussay halaq say utaar nahi sakay ga .   moat uss per her taraf say aarahi hogi , magar woh maray ga nahi ,   aur uss kay aagay ( hamesha ) aik aur sakht azab mojood hoga .

jinn logon  ney apney rab kay sath kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki hai , unn ki halat yeh hai kay unn kay aemal uss raakh ki tarah hain jissay aandhi toofan walay din mein hawa tezi say urra ley jaye .   unhon ney jo kuch kamai ki hogi , uss mein say kuch unn kay haath nahi aaye ga . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .
kiya tumhen yeh baat nazar nahi aati kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad say peda kiya hai . agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
aur yeh baat Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

aur yeh sabb log Allah kay aagay paish hon gay . phir jo log ( duniya mein ) kamzor thay , woh barai bgharney walon say kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay peechay chalney walay log thay , to kiya abb tum hamen Allah kay azab say kuch bacha lo gay-?  woh kahen gay :  agar Allah ney hamen hidayat di hoti to hum bhi tumhen hidayat dey detay . chahye hum cheekhen chilayen ya sabar keren , dono soorten humaray liye barabar hain , humaray liye chutkaray ka koi raasta nahi .

aur jab her baat ka faisla hojaye ga to shetan ( apney manney walon say ) kahey ga :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney tum say sacha wada kiya tha , aur mein ney tum say wada kiya to uss ki khilaf warzi ki . aur mujhay tum per iss say ziyada koi ikhtiyar hasil nahi tha kay mein ney tumhen ( Allah ki nafarmani ki ) dawat di to tum ney meri baat maan li . lehaza abb mujhay malamat naa kero , balkay khud apney aap ko malamat kero . naa tumhari fariyad per mein tumhari madad ker-sakta hun , aur naa meri fariyad per tum meri madad ker-saktay ho . tum ney iss say pehlay mujhay Allah ka jo shareek maan liya tha , ( aaj ) mein ney uss ka inkar kerdiya hai .   jinn logon  ney yeh zulm kiya tha , unn kay hissay mein to abb dardnak azab hai .

aur jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kiya jaye ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , apney perwerdigar kay hukum say woh unn ( baaghon ) mein hamesha rahen gay . woh aapas mein aik doosray ka istaqbal salam say keren gay .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney kalma tayyaba ki kaisi misal biyan ki hai ? woh aik pakeezah darkht ki tarah hai jiss ki jarr ( zameen mein ) mazbooti say jami hoi hai , aur uss ki shaakhen aasman mein hain ,
apney rab kay hukum say woh her aan phal deta hai .   Allah ( iss qisam ki ) misalen iss liye deta hai takay log naseehat hasil keren .
aur napak kalmay ki misal aik kharab darkht ki tarah hai jissay zameen kay oopper hi oopper say ukhaar liya jaye , uss mein zara bhi jamao naa ho .

jo log emaan laye hain , Allah unn ko iss mazboot baat per duniya ki zindagi mein bhi jamao ata kerta hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi .   aur zalim logon  ko Allah bhatka deta hai , aur Allah ( apni hikmat kay mutabiq ) jo chahta hai kerta hai .
kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhon ney Allah ki naimat ko kufr say badal daala , aur apni qoam ko tabahi kay ghar mein laa utaara
jiss ka naam jahannum hai ?   woh uss mein jalen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

aur unhon ney Allah kay sath ( uss ki khudai mein ) kuch shareek bana liye , takay logon  ko uss kay raastay say gumrah keren . unn say kaho kay :  ( thoray say ) mazay urra lo , kiyonkay aakhir kaar tumhen jana dozakh hi ki taraf hai .

meray jo banday emaan laye hain , unn say keh do kay woh namaz qaeem keren , aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai uss mein say posheeda tor per bhi aur aelania bhi ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch keren , ( aur yeh kaam ) uss din kay aaney say pehlay pehlay ( kerlen ) jiss mein naa koi kharid-o-farokht hogi , naa koi dosti kaam aaye gi .

Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay liye phal ugaye , aur kashtiyon ko tumharay liye raam kerdiya , takay woh uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalen , aur daryaon ko bhi tumhari khidmat per laga diya .
aur tumhari khatir sooraj aur chaand ko iss tarah kaam per lagaya kay woh musalsal safar mein hain , aur tumhari khatir raat aur din ko bhi kaam per lagaya .

aur tum ney jo kuch maanga , uss ney uss mein say ( jo tumharay liye munasib tha ) tumhen diya . aur agar tum Allah ki naimaton ko shumar kernay lago to shumar ( bhi ) nahi ker-saktay . haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht bey insaf , bara nashukra hai .

aur yaad kero woh waqt jab Ibrahim ney ( Allah taalaa say dua kertay huye ) kaha tha kay :  ya rab ! iss shehar ko pur aman bana dijiye ,   aur mujhay aur meray beton ko iss baat say bachaiye kay hum button ki parastish keren .

meray perwerdigar ! inn button ney logon  ki bari tadaad ko gumrah kiya hai . lehaza jo koi meri raah per chalay , woh to mera hai , aur jo mera kehna naa maaney , to ( uss ka moamla mein aap per chorta hun ) aap boht bakhshney walay baray meharban hain .

aey humaray perwerdigar ! mein ney apni kuch aulad ko aap kay hurmat walay ghar kay paas aik aesi wadi mein laa basaya hai jiss mein koi kheti nahi hoti . humaray perwerdigar ! ( yeh mein ney iss liye kiya ) takay yeh namaz qaeem keren , lehaza logon  kay dilon mein inn kay liye kashish peda ker-dijiye , aur inn ko phalon ka rizq ata farmaiye ,   takay woh shukar guzaar banen .

aey humaray rab ! hum jo kaam chup ker kertay hain , woh bhi aap kay ilm mein hain , aur jo kaam aelania kertay hain , woh bhi . aur Allah say naa zameen ki koi cheez chupi hoi hai , naa aasman ki koi cheez .
tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jiss ney mujhay burhapay mein Ismail aur Ishaq ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye . beyshak mera rab bara duayen sunney wala hai .
ya rab ! mujhay bhi namaz qaeem kernay wala bana dijiye , aur meri aulad mein say bhi ( aesay log peda farmaiye jo namaz qaeem keren . ) aey humaray perwerdigar ! aur meri dua qubool farma-lijiye .
aey humaray perwerdigar ! jiss din hisab qaeem hoga , uss din meri bhi maghfirat farmaiye , meray walaiden ki bhi ,   aur unn sabb ki bhi jo emaan rakhtay hain .

aur yeh hergiz naa samajhna kay jo kuch yeh zalim ker rahey hain , Allah uss say ghafil hai .   woh to unn logon  ko uss din tak kay liye mohlat dey raha hai jiss mein aankhen phatti ki phatti reh jayen gi .
woh saron ko oopper uthaye dorr rahey hon gay , unn ki nigahen jhapakney ko wapis nahi ayen gi ,   aur unn kay dil ( bad-hawasi mein ) urray jarahey hon gay .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum logon  ko uss din say khabrdar kero jab azab unn per aan parray ga , to uss waqt yeh zalim kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen thori si mauddat kay liye aur mohlat dey dijiye takay hum aap ki dawat qubool kerlen , aur payghumberon ki perwi keren .  ( uss waqt unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aray kiya tum logon  ney qasmen kha kha ker pehlay yeh nahi kaha tha kay tum per koi zawal nahi aa-sakta-?

aur tum unn logon  ki bastiyon mein reh chukay thay jinhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , aur yeh baat khul ker tumharay samney aa-chuki thi kay hum ney unn kay sath kaisa sulook kiya , aur hum ney tumhen misalen bhi di then .
aur woh log apni sari chaalen chal chukay thay , aur unn ki sari chaalon ka torr Allah kay paas tha , chahye inn/unn ki chaalen aesi kiyon naa hun jinn say pahar bhi apni jagah say hill jayen .

lehaza Allah kay baaray mein hergiz yeh khayal bhi dil mein naa lana kay uss ney apney payghumberon say jo wada ker rakha hai ,uss ki khilaf warzi keray ga . yaqeen rakho kay Allah apney iqtidar mein sabb per ghalib hai , ( aur ) intiqam lenay wala hai .
uss din jab yeh zameen aik doosri zameen say badal di jaye gi , aur aasman bhi ( badal jayen gay ) aur sabb kay sabb khudaye wahid o qahaar kay samney paish hon gay .
aur uss din tum mujrimon ko iss halat mein dekho gay kay woh zanjeeron mein jakray huye hon gay .
unn kay qamees tarkol kay hon gay , aur aag unn kay chehron per chai hoi hogi ,
takay Allah her shaks ko uss kay kiye ka badla dey . yaqeenan Allah jald hisab chukaney wala hai .

yeh tamam logon  kay liye aik paygham hai , aur iss liye diya jaraha hai takay unhen iss kay zariye khabrdar kiya jaye , aur takay woh jaan len kay mabood-e-bar-haq bus aik hi hai , aur takay samajh rakhney walay naseehat hasil kerlen .
